npcs.name: Old guy neighbour eve 1
npcs.text: I found this card on the floor while I was tidying up. I've been here all day and nobody has claimed it so you might as well take it!
npcs.repeat_text: How are you finding the neighbourhood? I normally visit the pier at the evening but I'm all worn out from cleaning up today. So wI think I will just go to bed early tonight.

npcs.name: Super Elder 1
npcs.text: Hoh Hoh, I imagine you're new in town ey? We're the 3 Super Elders of the harbour. If you are able to win against us you can gain access to the Gym Hero Challenge.
npcs.repeat_text: You'll need some better cards if you have a hope of beating us. Come back in a few days when you're more ready.

npcs.name: Policeman blocking beach BL
npcs.text: There's still some Sharepedo reported in the water so we can't let anyone through yet.
npcs.repeat_text: Can't let you through yet until the Sharepedo are gone. It should be safe in the morning

npcs.name: Maintenance guy fixing the lighthouse
npcs.text: I'm just about to replace the lighthouse bulb with a new one. It's a loooooonnnnng way to the top, probably about 10,000 steps! I'm getting too old to be doing this but it's an important job
npcs.repeat_text: Weellll... it's not really 10,000 steps but it feels like that many. Can't let the lightbulb get worn out - If it does it'll mean a lot of trouble for the harbour so the responsibility is larger than the climb up!

npcs.name: Maintenance guy blocking forest
npcs.text: Sorry, the forest is closed off while we do some essential maintenance. We had even more wind than usual last night resulting in a lot of falling branches causing a safety hazard.
npcs.repeat_text: Sorry but it's going to take a least a day or maybe two. Once we've cleared all the loose branches and removed the fallen trees it'll be safe for people to enter again.

npcs.name: Gift_Lady_Rose
npcs.text: Here, take this card! I have far too many duplicates.
npcs.post_gift_text: I just keep finding duplicates everywhere I look!

npcs.name: Coin_Collector_Pete
npcs.text: I found this coin on the harbour floor, you take it.
npcs.post_gift_text: I always seem to find coins wherever I walk. Maybe I should check the floor more often!

npcs.name: Generous_Gerald
npcs.text: My uncle gave me some spending money, here take some!
npcs.post_gift_text: My uncle is always really generous, I think it runs in the family!

opponents.name: Youngster_Joey
opponents.meet_text: I just got given some cards off my grandma, she's so cool. I'm not really good at battling yet but it's a lot of fun!
opponents.first_win_text: Take these full heal cards, you can use them to heal any status conditions your pokemon get. They're really useful.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm going to win one day!
opponents.loss_text: I didn't expect to win at all! These cards must be really good

opponents.name: Gardener Callum
opponents.meet_text: Wowee, it was a long day gardening today. I'm down for a match to let off some steam now.
opponents.rematch_text: I've got time for a rematch before my next shift.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm clearly too worn out from such a long shift.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll win when I'm fully rested.
opponents.loss_text: Even after a hard days work I can still win!

opponents.name: Engineer Allan
opponents.meet_text: As you can see, the new bulb installation went perrrrfectly today. I'm worn out from all the steps but always game for a match.
opponents.rematch_text: I won't be needing to replace the bulb any time soon so I've got time to kill.
opponents.first_win_text: That was clearly toooooo many steps today
opponents.rematch_win_text: At least I'm reaaallly good at replacing bulbs.
opponents.loss_text: I hope your loss didn't come as a shock to you.

opponents.name: Gambler_Mick
opponents.meet_text: All I need is a bit of luck, I let that decide my fate. If I battle enough then I'm bound to win some of them at least
opponents.rematch_text: I'll be a lot luckier this time round
opponents.first_win_text: Luck really wasn't on my side today...
opponents.rematch_win_text: I just need a little bit of luck that's all
opponents.loss_text: Looks like luck wasn't on your side today

opponents.name: Schoolboy_Adam
opponents.meet_text: I'm trying out some new techniques using statuses. If we battle I'll show you how good they are
opponents.rematch_text: I'll definitely win this time round
opponents.first_win_text: Oh man I really thought my statuses were going to cause you some trouble
opponents.rematch_win_text: Maybe I need a better tactic...
opponents.loss_text: I knew my status infliction technique would work!

opponents.name: Fisherman_Dave
opponents.meet_text: I love the lighthouse here, it seems to attract all kinds of fish so I always catch a lot in this spot. I'm catching so many I need a break
opponents.rematch_text: I've caught a lot since last time.
opponents.first_win_text: Even if they don't help me win, I still love my fish
opponents.rematch_win_text: Fishing and Pokemon cards are both a lot of fun, I could do both all day.
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should try picking up a rod and give fishing a go instead!

opponents.name: Fisherman_John
opponents.meet_text: Me and my buddy Dave fish here all the time. The lighthouse is like a giant lure in the evening so we catch even more. I've got time for a break.
opponents.rematch_text: The evening is still young if you want another match.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm a much better fisherman than I am a card player.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Always happy to put my fishing aside for a rematch.
opponents.loss_text: I'm not just the best round here at fishing!
